NOTICE TO ALL PERSONNEL

The surface elevator is OUT OF SERVICE pending inspection.

In the event of a site emergency, personnel should proceed to their sector muster points and await instruction. Do not attempt to use the stairwells to ascend: stairwell access above Floor 1 is sealed as a containment measure.

We appreciate your patience.

— Facilities
(Someone has written underneath, in ballpoint, pressed hard: THE ELEVATOR HAS BEEN 'PENDING INSPECTION' FOR THREE YEARS. NOBODY LEAVES. ASK YOURSELF WHY THE STAIRS ONLY GO DOWN.)
